title: Copy Confirm
summary: Shows exactly what was copied and flags stray spaces or hidden characters, so the wrong thing isn't pasted somewhere important.
description: Shows exactly what was copied, refuses to copy an empty value, flags stray whitespace and invisible characters with a one-tap clean copy, and can copy formatted numbers as plain text.
catches: Leading or trailing whitespace and invisible characters, with a clean copy
Formatted numbers (grouping, currency) copied when plain digits were needed
limits: Can't see what the user pastes afterwards or where
Clipboard access can fail or be blocked by the browser; the failure is shown
a11y: Icon-only button gets an aria-label; it is described by the feedback while open
Feedback is aria-live="polite"; Escape closes it
Icons are aria-hidden; the copied text is shown in a <code> element
stops: Pasted the wrong thing from the clipboard
